GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 300.62 (13 Dec 45) ESS/IN
(SCAPIN - 433)
APO 500
13 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Return of Essential Records and Engineering Data
1. During the occupation of the Philippines by the Japanese, the National Power Corporation, Manila, was placed under the Taiwan Electric Company, whose head office is in Japan. Engineers of the Taiwan Electric Company, then assigned in the Philippines, made copies of essential hydrologic data of the principal power rivers of the Philippines. The National Power Corporation had also made project studies with preliminary plans for the development of power plants on several rivers in Luzon and the Lake Lanao-Agus River area in Mindanao. It is known that these hydro-logic data and development plans were in the hands of the Japanese authorities.
2. You are directed to locate and deliver all such records and data referred to in par. 1 above to this Headquarters on or before 10 Jan. 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
